|translation='''Title:''' Timer Mine (Dark).

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where one of your mine-laying droids is present. It "explodes" on your next turn. Draw destiny. That many opposing characters there are immediately lost; the opponent may choose who is lost. The timer mine is also lost at that point.

'''Lore:'''
A timed bomb set by a mine-laying droid. Developed for blasting ore veins and spice mines, it has been modified for military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese deploys at a location card and explodes on your next turn.
